scenario: Activation-creation order within a rule per LDET.5.5 — when the same rule has multiple activations, the one whose binding tuple was completed earliest fires first. Trig(v=1) is asserted before Trig(v=2); rule r fires twice, first for v=1 then v=2, producing log messages in that order.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log critical "{t.v}"
